transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what's been bothering you or what brought you in to see me today?

I guess… I’ve just been messing up basic things a lot. Like paying bills, replying to interview emails, making it to appointments, errands. I keep forgetting or not following through, and it’s started to actually cost me opportunities.
Have you experienced this kind of forgetfulness and trouble following through since you were a child, or is this something that started more recently, like in the past few months?

No, it’s not just recent. I mean… I remember it being there even in elementary school. Teachers would say I was bright, but I lost worksheets all the time, didn’t really follow directions carefully, talked when I wasn’t supposed to, and my desk was always a mess. Like, I couldn’t find assignments in it.
Besides the forgetfulness and disorganization, do you also notice things like feeling restless, having trouble sitting still, fidgeting, or acting or speaking impulsively without thinking it through?

Yeah… I do get restless. Like if I’m sitting through an interview or a meeting, or even just a movie, I start feeling this pressure in my body. I have to shift around or mess with something in my hands, otherwise it feels like I’m going to crawl out of my skin.
Do you often find yourself interrupting others in conversation, blurting out answers before someone finishes speaking, or acting on impulse without thinking things through?

Yeah… I do that. I’ll jump in because I think I know what they’re about to ask, especially in interviews or conversations, and then sometimes I realize I cut them off or answered the wrong thing. It’s embarrassing.
Do these struggles with focus, restlessness, and impulsivity show up in multiple areas of your life—like at work, at home, and in your relationships—or is it mostly limited to one setting?

It’s… not just one place. Since I got fired, it’s kind of been showing up everywhere that I need to keep track of things. I’ve missed follow-ups for interviews, and I had to step back from a volunteer project I actually cared about because I just couldn’t keep up reliably. So… yeah, it feels like I can’t manage the basic steps to move forward right now.
Have you noticed any periods of low mood, excessive worry, or use of alcohol/drugs that started around the same time as these concentration and organization problems?
I’m not really sure. I mean… I’ve been stressed, obviously, but I don’t think there was some separate mood thing or drinking or drugs that started it. The focus stuff feels like it’s just been there.
Over the past couple of weeks, have you noticed feeling persistently sad, down, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?
I don’t know… not really persistently sad, I guess. I’ve been stressed, but I haven’t really thought of it as losing interest in things.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about a lot of different things, more days than not, even when there's no clear reason to worry?
Not really… I mean, I worry when there’s something going on, but I don’t think it’s like all the time or for no reason. I’m not sure.
How has your sleep been lately—are you sleeping enough, and do you wake up feeling rested?
Um… I’m not sure. I sleep, but I don’t always feel that rested. I haven’t really been tracking it or anything.
Have you ever had a distinct period, lasting several days, where you felt unusually high, elated, or irritable, needed much less sleep than usual, and had racing thoughts or grand ideas?
I don’t think so… I mean, I’ve had times where I’m more wound up or irritable, but not like several days where I barely needed sleep and felt amazing or anything. I’m not really sure.
